cues.zh: [观众] 我想请教您关于挖矿能耗的问题。
cues.en: [AUDIENCE] I want to ask you about the energy consumption in mining.

cues.zh: [安德烈亚斯] 是吗？[观众] 那有什么解决办法呢？
cues.en: [ANDREAS] Yes? [AUDIENCE] What is the solution for it?

cues.zh: [安德烈亚斯] 嗯，挖矿的能源消耗——我认为——经常被两方面误导。
cues.en: [ANDREAS] Well, energy consumption in mining is -- I think -- misrepresented very often in two ways.

cues.zh: [加密货币]挖矿是少数完全不受地理位置限制的行业之一，
cues.en: [Cryptocurrency] mining is one of the few industries that is completely geographically independent,

cues.zh: 也就是说，只要电力便宜，你在哪里挖矿都无所谓。
cues.en: meaning that it doesn't matter where you are if you are mining, as long as you have inexpensive electricity.

cues.zh: 这就让你能够完全根据当地的电价来选择挖矿系统的位置，
cues.en: What that allows you to do, is choose the location of your mining system based entirely on

cues.zh: 这意味着
cues.en: the local cost of electricity, which means that

cues.zh: 挖矿实际上是在对最便宜的电力来源进行市场套利。
cues.en: mining is doing market arbitrage for the cheapest sources of electricity.

cues.zh: 很多时候，电力来源便宜的原因是
cues.en: In many cases, the reason the source of electricity is cheap, is because

cues.zh: 它无法匹配当地的用电需求，
cues.en: it does not match the demand at that location,

cues.zh: 尤其是在那些没有广泛部署高效电力配送网络的国家。
cues.en: [especially] in countries where there aren't broadly deployed, efficient distribution networks for electricity.

cues.zh: 快速部署和发展能源的挑战之一在于，你建一座发电厂
cues.en: One of the challenges with rapidly deploying and developing energy, is that you build a power plant

cues.zh: 不是为了今天的需求，而是为了未来15年的需求。
cues.en: not for the demand that it has today, but for the demand that you're going to have over the next 15 years.

cues.zh: 你现在就得投资，然后逐步成长，因为你不能简单地跨
cues.en: You have to make that investment now and grow into it, because you can't simply move energy across

cues.zh: 一个幅员辽阔的国家输送能源，如果没有配电网络的话。我说的是中国，如果你还没猜到的话。
cues.en: a massive country when you don't have a distribution network. I'm speaking of China, if you didn't figure it out.

cues.zh: 这是他们面临的根本问题之一。
cues.en: That's one of the fundamental problems they have.

cues.zh: 这个问题不仅在中国存在，在发展中国家以及许多发达国家也同样存在。
cues.en: This problem is replicated across not just China but developing nations, as well as many developed nations.

cues.zh: 需要电力的地方，以及需要电力的时间，
cues.en: The places where electricity is needed, and the times when electricity is needed,

cues.zh: 几乎总是与电力可用的地方和时间不匹配。
cues.en: are almost always not the places and times where electricity is available.

cues.zh: 在一个只有15兆瓦需求的地方建一座50兆瓦的发电厂，会发生什么？
cues.en: What happens when you build a 50-megawatt plant in a place where they only have 15 megawatts of demand?

cues.zh: 如果是风能、太阳能或水能这类替代能源，你没法关掉它，也没法调低输出。
cues.en: If it's alternative energy like wind, solar, or hydro, you can't turn it off or turn it down.

cues.zh: 建好了，它就会发电，然后呢？基本上就是在浪费能源。
cues.en: You've built it, it will produce, and then what? You're basically wasting energy.

cues.zh: 如果在那种环境下，你能想办法把那些能源转化成另一种价值储存手段呢？
cues.en: What if, in that environment, you could find a way to turn that energy into an alternative store of value?

cues.zh: 那么发电厂不用五年回本，而是一年就能回本，
cues.en: Then instead of paying off the electricity plant in five years, you pay off in one year,

cues.zh: 靠的就是本来会被浪费掉的电力。
cues.en: by using electricity that would otherwise be wasted.

cues.zh: 比特币是对全世界替代能源的一种环境补贴，
cues.en: Bitcoin is an environmental subsidy to alternative energy all around the world,

cues.zh: 因为它让这些项目一年就能摊销完，而不是五年。
cues.en: because it's causing these projects to be amortized over a year instead of five.

cues.zh: 哦，你是说我们一直在跑一个绿色币，而我居然都没注意到？
cues.en: Oh, you're telling me we were running a green coin all this time and I didn't even notice?

cues.zh: 一个问题是……你得从供需平衡的角度来理解这件事
cues.en: One problem is that... You've got to understand it from the perspective of balancing supply and demand

cues.zh: 在全球范围内，在没有配送网络的情况下。
cues.en: on a global scale without distribution networks.

cues.zh: 比特币的去中心化正在推动能源生产的去中心化，
cues.en: The decentralization of Bitcoin is driving the decentralization of energy production,

cues.zh: 这是人类历史上最重要的趋势之一。
cues.en: which is one of the most important trends in human history.

cues.zh: 另外你要记住的一点是，比特币很容易因为能耗问题被批评
cues.en: One of the other things you've got to keep in mind is that Bitcoin is easy to criticise for its energy consumption

cues.zh: 因为这一点显而易见。还有很多更浪费的事情，远没那么明显。
cues.en: because it's obvious. There are a lot more wasteful things that are far less obvious.

cues.zh: 每次你掏出那张小塑料卡做交易时，你并不会意识到
cues.en: Every time you pull out that little plastic card and you use it to do a transaction, you're not aware of

cues.zh: 那座十万平方英尺的数据中心，正让十万台服务器轰鸣运转来做欺诈检测。
cues.en: the hundred-thousand square foot data center, churning a hundred thousand servers to do fraud detection.

cues.zh: 或者说清算。你可能没意识到那些塔楼办公室全天二十四小时灯火通明；
cues.en: Or clearing. You're not aware of the tower offices that are lit twenty-four hours a day;

cues.zh: 交易大厅、银行金库、装甲车、柴油卡车等等。
cues.en: the trading floors, the bank vaults, the armored cars, the diesel trucks, etc.

cues.zh: 所有这些成本大多是隐形的，而且极其庞大。你是在告诉我……
cues.en: All of those costs are mostly hidden and they're enormous. Are you telling me...

cues.zh: 也许比特币最终会成为全球范围内最高效的交易方式？
cues.en: that perhaps Bitcoin ends up being the most efficient way to do transactions on a global scale?

cues.zh: 你得记住：我们今天为比特币提供的安全级别，
cues.en: You've got to remember: the level of security we have for Bitcoin today,

cues.zh: 是能够抵御全球性攻击的安全级别，能对抗串通的民族国家。
cues.en: is a level of security that can handle global attacks, by colluding nation-states.

cues.zh: 这是让这个系统保持抗审查所需的安全级别。
cues.en: That's the level of security needed for this system to remain censorship-resistant.

cues.zh: 但如果系统规模扩大十倍、用户多十倍，它并不需要十倍的挖矿算力。
cues.en: But if the system was ten times bigger with ten times more users, it doesn't need ten times more mining.

cues.zh: 它已经拥有全球级安全的挖矿。我们现有的已经足够了。有利润动机在驱动它。
cues.en: It already has globally-secure mining. What we have is enough. There's a profit motive that drives it.

cues.zh: 认为走向全球后成本也会成倍增长，这是个错误。事实上恰恰相反。
cues.en: It's a mistake to think that if we go global, that cost will also multiply. Quite the opposite, in fact.

cues.zh: 随着时间推移，挖矿的奖励会减少；
cues.en: Over time, the reward from mining decreases;

cues.zh: 因此，我们更可能看到它逐渐减弱并趋于平稳。
cues.en: as a result it's more likely we'll see that gradually taper off and plateau.

cues.zh: 这是一场长期博弈。成本如何分配、能源如何消耗，其影响和复杂性都是巨大的。
cues.en: This is a long game. The implications and complexity of how cost is allocated, how energy is consumed, is huge.

cues.zh: 我认为这个星球上负担不起两个工作量证明系统；我觉得我们可能只需要一个。
cues.en: I don't think we can afford two proof-of-work systems on this planet; I think we might only need one.

cues.zh: 也许其他一切都可以是权益证明，并锚定到我们唯一的工作量证明系统上。
cues.en: Maybe everything else could be proof-of-stake and anchor into the only proof-of-work system we have.

cues.zh: 我们需要一个行星规模的工作量证明系统，为我们提供真正依赖能源的不可篡改性，
cues.en: We need one planetary-scale proof-of-work system to offer us true energy-dependent immutability,

cues.zh: 但也许我们只负担得起一个。事实证明，这可能正是比特币的杀手级应用！
cues.en: but maybe we can only afford one. Turns out, that might be Bitcoin's killer app!
